name: Idle Fade Throttle
description: GNOME fades the screen to black over 10 seconds when the session goes idle. That fade is a full-screen translucent overlay, so every frame forces a full recomposite of the whole stage -- ~10 s of 100% CPU, even on a single internal display. This replaces the per-frame fade with a stepped one (default 3 steps: 33% / 66% / 100%): same duration, hundreds of times less CPU.
